target: Observed selected-chain category presence at a stable municipal building
candidate_policy: Valid nonempty municipal footprint with a uniquely matched municipal address; independent of outlet labels
background_policy: Uniform stable SHA256 ordering within each pool/category, independently for development and final partitions; known same-category positives excluded; all sampled labels remain unknown

split.policy: Fixed projected quadrants; purge distance <=2000m from each held-out quadrant extent. Final-region purging also applies to development validation. All rows of one building share a fold.

competition_policy: Deferred until a separate version defines fold-aware target masking and duplicate exclusion
preprocessing_policy: Fit imputation, scaling and encoding on training data only; preserve missingness and censoring; no zero filling of unknown population; remove focal-building venues and activity
tuning_policy: Only development geographic folds; nested spatial tuning within their training regions. Final northeast holdout stays sealed until models and hyperparameters are locked.

baseline_algorithm.preprocessing: Training-fold median imputation plus missing/censored indicators and training-fold standard scaling; no unknown-to-zero population conversion; identically reused on evaluation rows

promotion_gate.comparison: Both declared population/access baselines plus prevalence/random retrieval
promotion_gate.interpretation: Retrieval of observed selected-chain sites under the frozen background sample; not commercial success, calibrated population probabilities or directly comparable category scores
promotion_gate.threshold_basis: Predeclared planning thresholds and workload choices, not empirically validated constants
